name: Testimonial 1
description: Three case-study quote cards drawn as folder tabs (stretched SVG outline with a top notch). Scanline-dithered canvas art in the brand color, notched arrow pills with slide-in fills, and a damped scroll-linked stagger entrance.
interactions: entrance: scroll-linked per-card stagger (0.18 offset), damped lerp (x += (t-x)*0.14), scale 0.88->1, translateY 200->0, opacity 0->1
arrow pill hover: dark fill layer slides in from -56px at 5% opacity, 260ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); link scales 1.05 hover / 0.96 active
canvas art: 2D scanline dither of a glyph silhouette, fill color read from --btn-bg-enable at runtime
art re-renders on data-brand / data-theme changes via MutationObserver
prefers-reduced-motion: entrance pinned to final state
